name: Angelo 2.1 (open-source Blender fork with a built-in AI agent)
summary: Free, open-source fork of Blender (based on Blender 5.3.0) with an AI agent that works in your real scene using your own Claude/ChatGPT subscription or API key. 2.1 adds a built-in Retopology tool (42/42 runs on the publisher's frozen test set vs 22 for QuadriFlow), rig tools (retarget, game rigs for Unreal/Unity/Godot, IK), Shape Cut, Scatter, UV Layout, collision hulls and Splats to Mesh. macOS (Apple silicon) and Windows.

publisher.name: Hyperbond Studio Pte. Ltd. (Angelo / Call Me Sensei)

access.license: GPL-3.0-or-later as distributed (own source files GPL-2.0-or-later)
access.price: $0 for individuals (bring your own model, billed by your provider); Team $10/seat/month; Enterprise $400/org/month
access.notes: Agent needs your own Claude/ChatGPT subscription or API key. Angelo name/logos not covered by GPL. Not affiliated with the Blender Foundation. Linux planned for 2.2. macOS 26+ on Apple silicon or Windows x64.

procedure: Download Angelo-2.1.0-macos-arm64.dmg (macOS 26+, Apple silicon) or Angelo-2.1.0-windows-x64.msi (Windows x64)
Optionally check the file against the published .sha256
Install, launch, and connect your Claude or ChatGPT subscription or your own API key for the agent

stats.size: macOS DMG ~501 MB; Windows MSI ~576 MB

verdict.why: Real downloadable GPL app (Blender fork) with installers and full source; 2.1 bundles retopo, rigging and splat-to-mesh tools artists usually buy as add-ons. 90K views / 1.4K saves on the launch post. Agent features need a paid model subscription or key; benchmark numbers are the publisher's own.
